fact: Seychelles Nation reports the government launched a revamped gov.sc, the official Government Portal, designed to give access to services and information.
The Government of Seychelles' monServis portal lets users access, communicate and transact with government services online through listed eServices.
The monServis portal carries eServices from multiple providers, with individuals signing in with SeyID and organisations onboarding through Biz Auth, per the Government of Seychelles.
The Seychelles Pension Fund says members can access their Statement of Account online through My e-Services and employers can submit contribution records through the e-Contribution Platform.

Seychelles modernised government services through the monServis portal in 2024, and the Import and Export permit online service migrates to it from the E-Services Gateway on 1 May 2026, per the Trade Division and DICT.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that Seychelles has an online public service portal, the eservice.egov.sc E-Services Gateway, rated transactional (level 3 or 4); the line gives no other year, so the round's year is used.
